pairs.subject: data-plane-transport-selection
pairs.evidence: app/data/snapshot.json/route.ts:23 The context's routes return a single HTTP Response built from a store read, with no second transport beside it. I searched the 11 context files for zero-copy, SharedArrayBuffer, brokered, MessageChannel, worker_threads, postMessage and transferable and found nothing. The same search over app/features/lib/scripts/packages, excluding node_modules, also found nothing. So there is no supervised process graph and no choice between brokered and direct transport here.

techniques.evidence: app/admin/loops.json/route.ts:35 This is a request/response read of loop state. No supervisor event loop sits on a message hot path.
app/data/snapshot.json/route.ts:23 The payload is a JSON string handed to a Response. No ownership-taking zero-copy send exists.
app/admin/loops.json/route.ts:36 There is only one delivery path, so there is no second transport to audit.
